items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: and Benny Bailey played a very beautiful solo all by himself on "Out Of Nowhere."

ctx.x: Well, I'm not going to mention his name. But anyway... And so, we had a postponement. And while we were waiting for the time to come around, Mr. Rappaport was jailed for selling pornographic magazines to kids. [LAUGHS] He ended up on Alcatraz.

Anyway, we did "Steady With Teddy" and "Bird Legs" and "Body And Soul" and "Roy's Boy," and Benny Bailey played a very beautiful solo all by himself on "Out Of Nowhere." All the compositions were mine, except "Out Of Nowhere" and "Body and Soul" and "Bird Legs," which was Benny Bailey's composition.
